parmed_bd module#

class arbdmodel.parmed_bd.ParmedArbd(parmed_structure=None, psf=None, pdb=None, parameter_files=None, system_type='charmm', integrator='MD', cutoff=12, **kwargs)[source]#

Bases: ArbdModel

Class for converting ParmEd structures to ARBD models for simulation.

This class facilitates the conversion of molecular structures loaded with ParmEd into ARBD simulation models, preserving bonded and non-bonded interactions. It also supports creating dual topology models for free energy calculations.

parmed_structure#

The original ParmEd structure

atom_types#

Dictionary mapping atom type names to ParticleType objects

atoms_map#

Mapping from ParmEd atoms to ARBD atoms
